At the bottom of the {wiki:Mount Sternum Undead Cave|Mount Sternum Undead Cave}, near Thais, a {creature:Dwarf Geomancer} and his guards protect a chest. Go down several floors, pass the {wiki:Graveyard of the Doomed|Graveyard of the Doomed} and the undead, and open the quest box to receive a {item:Small Sapphire}, a {item:Small Diamond} and a {item:Dwarven Ring}.

Bring potions and something against poison because of the {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}.
1. Going down to the Undead Cave

{wiki:Mount Sternum|Mount Sternum} is **northeast** of Thais and southwest of Kazordoon ({coord:32494,32072,7}): leave Thais on foot to the northeast (if you are not in Thais, take a boat and tell the captain {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}). Find a hole in the centre of the mountain and go down the stairs at the indicated spot. The {wiki:Mount Sternum/Undead Cave|Undead Cave} also has a surface entrance at {coord:32418,32017,7}, near the witch's tower south of Kazordoon, and another through the Mount Sternum cyclops cave.
Undead Cave entrance (next to the witch's tower)
Stairs in the middle of Mount Sternum
Follow the path in the image, past the {wiki:Graveyard of the Doomed|Graveyard of the Doomed}, to the **west** and then **north**, and go down a floor.
Path west and north to the descent
Go straight **northwest** and go down the hole.
North and first on the left
Go **north**, turn **west** at the first turning and go down the hole.
Go **east** and go down a hole.
Here you face {creature:Mummy|Mummies}, {creature:Crypt Shambler|Crypt Shamblers} and {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}. Kill them, go **east** and go down one more floor.
Path east to the last descent
The quest chest is on the **east** side of this room, behind a few {creature:Dwarf Guard|Dwarf Guards} and a {creature:Dwarf Geomancer}. Kill them and open the chest.

Go back the same way, following the maps in reverse: climb the floors you went down and use the {item:Rope} on each hole (east, west, northwest), pass the Graveyard of the Doomed again and climb the stairs in the centre of the mountain ({coord:32441,32008,13}) to the surface. From there walk back **southwest** to Thais.
